/* BUDGETGENIUS_CANARY_RUNTIME_V0_5_BEGIN */
const BUDGETGENIUS_CANARY_RUNTIME_VERSION='0.5';
const BUDGETGENIUS_CANARY_RUNTIME_KEY='pv_budgetgenius_canary_v05';
function budgetGeniusCanaryCanonicalJson(v){if(Array.isArray(v))return '['+v.map(budgetGeniusCanaryCanonicalJson).join(',')+']';if(v&&typeof v==='object')return '{'+Object.keys(v).sort().map(function(k){return JSON.stringify(k)+':'+budgetGeniusCanaryCanonicalJson(v[k]);}).join(',')+'}';return JSON.stringify(v);}
async function budgetGeniusCanarySha256(s){if(!globalThis.crypto||!globalThis.crypto.subtle)throw new Error('WEBCRYPTO_REQUIRED_FOR_CANARY_LEASE');const b=new TextEncoder().encode(String(s));const d=await globalThis.crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',b);return Array.from(new Uint8Array(d)).map(function(x){return x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0');}).join('');}
function budgetGeniusCanarySnapshotHash(row){const x=Object.assign({},row||{});delete x.runtimeSnapshotHash;return fastHash(JSON.stringify(x));}
function budgetGeniusCanaryWrite(row){const x=Object.assign({},row||{});x.runtimeSnapshotHash=budgetGeniusCanarySnapshotHash(x);localStorage.setItem(BUDGETGENIUS_CANARY_RUNTIME_KEY,JSON.stringify(x));return x;}
function budgetGeniusCanaryRead(){try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(BUDGETGENIUS_CANARY_RUNTIME_KEY);if(!raw)return null;const x=JSON.parse(raw);if(!x||x.version!==BUDGETGENIUS_CANARY_RUNTIME_VERSION)return null;if(x.runtimeSnapshotHash!==budgetGeniusCanarySnapshotHash(x)){localStorage.removeItem(BUDGETGENIUS_CANARY_RUNTIME_KEY);try{if(typeof appendReceipt==='function')appendReceipt({receiptType:'BudgetGeniusCanaryRuntimeReceipt',version:'0.5',status:'ROLLBACK_REQUIRED',reason:'RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT_TAMPER',timestamp:Date.now()});}catch(_e){}return null;}return x;}catch(_e){return null;}}
function budgetGeniusCanaryApprovalRoles(approvals){const s=new Set((Array.isArray(approvals)?approvals:[]).map(function(a){return String(a&&a.role||'').toUpperCase();}));return ['OPERATOR','STEWARD','BOARD'].every(function(r){return s.has(r);});}
function budgetGeniusCanaryBudgetPassValid(lease,bg){const p=bg&&bg.pass,plan=bg&&bg.plan,res=bg&&bg.reservation;if(!p||!plan||!res)return false;if(p.state!=='RESERVED')return false;if(p.passId!==lease.budgetPassRef)return false;if(p.mandateId!==lease.mandateRef)return false;if(p.selectedRouteId!==lease.scope.routeIds[0])return false;if(Number(p.reservedUsd||0)!==0)return false;if(!plan.selected||plan.selected.routeId!==p.selectedRouteId)return false;if(res.ok!==true)return false;return true;}
async function budgetGeniusCanaryRuntimeInstall(lease,budgetPassResult){const l=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(lease||{}));if(l.schema!=='superphivessel.budgetgenius.canary-lease.v0.4')throw new Error('INVALID_CANARY_LEASE_SCHEMA');const expected=String(l.leaseHash||'');delete l.leaseHash;const actual=await budgetGeniusCanarySha256(budgetGeniusCanaryCanonicalJson(l));if(!expected||actual!==expected)throw new Error('CANARY_LEASE_SHA256_MISMATCH');l.leaseHash=expected;if(l.qualificationDisposition!=='EMPIRICAL_QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE')throw new Error('CANARY_NOT_EMPIRICALLY_QUALIFIED');if(!budgetGeniusCanaryApprovalRoles(l.approvals))throw new Error('CANARY_APPROVAL_SET_INCOMPLETE');if(!l.authority||l.authority.routeInfluenceOnly!==true||l.authority.mayDispatch!==false||l.authority.mayGrantPaidApproval!==false||l.authority.mayMintAuthority!==false||l.authority.mayBypassExecutorAuthorization!==false||l.authority.executorAuthorizationRequired!==true)throw new Error('CANARY_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY_INVALID');const issued=Date.parse(l.issuedAt),expires=Date.parse(l.expiresAt);if(!Number.isFinite(issued)||!Number.isFinite(expires)||expires<=issued||expires-issued>300000)throw new Error('CANARY_LIVE_DURATION_EXCEEDS_5_MINUTES');if(Date.now()>=expires)throw new Error('CANARY_LEASE_ALREADY_EXPIRED');if(!l.scope||!Array.isArray(l.scope.taskClasses)||l.scope.taskClasses.length!==1||l.scope.taskClasses[0]!=='code')throw new Error('CANARY_LIVE_TASK_SCOPE_MUST_BE_CODE_ONLY');if(!Array.isArray(l.scope.routeIds)||l.scope.routeIds.length!==1)throw new Error('CANARY_LIVE_ROUTE_SCOPE_MUST_BE_EXACTLY_ONE');if(Number(l.scope.maxDecisions)!==1)throw new Error('CANARY_LIVE_DECISION_LIMIT_MUST_BE_ONE');if(Number(l.scope.maxCumulativeShadowSpendUsd)!==0||Number(l.scope.maxPerDecisionSpendUsd)!==0)throw new Error('CANARY_LIVE_PAID_SPEND_MUST_BE_ZERO');const routeId=String(l.scope.routeIds[0]||'');if(!routeId.startsWith('ollama::'))throw new Error('CANARY_LIVE_ROUTE_MUST_BE_LOCAL_OLLAMA');const model=routeId.slice('ollama::'.length);if(!model||!ollamaModelIsLocal(model))throw new Error('CANARY_LOCAL_MODEL_NOT_DISCOVERED');const approved=brainApprovedModelsState();if(!approved||!Array.isArray(approved.models)||approved.models.indexOf(model)<0)throw new Error('CANARY_MODEL_OUTSIDE_OPERATOR_APPROVED_POOL');if(!budgetGeniusCanaryBudgetPassValid(l,budgetPassResult))throw new Error('CANARY_BUDGETPASS_NOT_RESERVED_FOR_EXACT_ROUTE');const row=budgetGeniusCanaryWrite({version:BUDGETGENIUS_CANARY_RUNTIME_VERSION,status:'ARMED',leaseId:l.leaseId,leaseHash:l.leaseHash,qualificationId:l.qualificationId,mandateRef:l.mandateRef,budgetPassRef:l.budgetPassRef,issuedAt:l.issuedAt,expiresAt:l.expiresAt,stage:'builder',taskClass:'code',routeId:routeId,candidateModel:model,decisionsUsed:0,maxDecisions:1,paidSpendCeilingUsd:0,executorAuthorizationRequired:true,authorityGranted:false,installedAt:Date.now()});try{if(typeof appendReceipt==='function')appendReceipt({receiptType:'BudgetGeniusCanaryRuntimeReceipt',version:'0.5',status:'ARMED',leaseId:row.leaseId,leaseHash:row.leaseHash,budgetPassRef:row.budgetPassRef,routeId:row.routeId,authorityGranted:false,executorAuthorizationRequired:true,timestamp:Date.now()});}catch(_e){}return row;}
function budgetGeniusCanaryRuntimeInfluence(decision,opts){const base=decision||{},o=opts||{},s=budgetGeniusCanaryRead();if(!s||s.status!=='ARMED')return base;if(Date.now()>=Date.parse(s.expiresAt)){budgetGeniusCanaryWrite(Object.assign({},s,{status:'EXPIRED',rollbackReason:'LEASE_EXPIRED'}));return base;}if(s.decisionsUsed>=1){budgetGeniusCanaryWrite(Object.assign({},s,{status:'CONSUMED'}));return base;}if(o.needProxy===true||base.stage!=='builder'||!base.task||base.task.taskClass!=='code')return base;if(!ACTIVE_RUN_CAPSULE||!Array.isArray(ACTIVE_RUN_CAPSULE.approvedModels)||ACTIVE_RUN_CAPSULE.approvedModels.indexOf(s.candidateModel)<0){budgetGeniusCanaryWrite(Object.assign({},s,{status:'ROLLBACK_REQUIRED',rollbackReason:'RUN_CAPSULE_MODEL_NOT_APPROVED'}));return base;}if(!ollamaModelIsLocal(s.candidateModel)){budgetGeniusCanaryWrite(Object.assign({},s,{status:'ROLLBACK_REQUIRED',rollbackReason:'MODEL_NOT_LOCAL'}));return base;}const compat=computeBrokerLocalCompatibility(s.candidateModel,base.task,o.files||[],base.role);if(!compat||compat.compatible!==true){budgetGeniusCanaryWrite(Object.assign({},s,{status:'ROLLBACK_REQUIRED',rollbackReason:'CANDIDATE_NOT_COMPATIBLE'}));return base;}const rec={receiptType:'BudgetGeniusCanaryInfluenceReceipt',version:'0.5',id:makeId('bg-canary'),leaseId:s.leaseId,leaseHash:s.leaseHash,qualificationId:s.qualificationId,mandateRef:s.mandateRef,budgetPassRef:s.budgetPassRef,baselineRoute:base.route||null,baselineProvider:base.provider||null,baselineModel:base.model||null,canaryRoute:'BUDGETGENIUS_CANARY_LOCAL',canaryProvider:'ollama',canaryModel:s.candidateModel,routeChanged:true,routeInfluenceAuthorizedByLease:true,executionAuthorized:false,mayDispatch:false,executorAuthorizationRequired:true,authorityGranted:false,paidApprovalGranted:false,paidSpendUsd:0,timestamp:Date.now()};budgetGeniusCanaryWrite(Object.assign({},s,{status:'CONSUMED',decisionsUsed:1,lastInfluenceReceiptId:rec.id,consumedAt:Date.now()}));try{if(typeof appendReceipt==='function')appendReceipt(rec);}catch(_e){}try{if(typeof phiEventEmit==='function')phiEventEmit('budgetgenius.canary_route_influenced',{metadata:{leaseId:s.leaseId,route:s.routeId,model:s.candidateModel,executionAuthorized:false}});}catch(_e){}return Object.assign({},base,{route:'BUDGETGENIUS_CANARY_LOCAL',provider:'ollama',model:s.candidateModel,local:true,brokerInitiatedPaid:false,requiresPaidApproval:false,paidApproved:false,reason:'BudgetGenius v0.5 one-shot local canary influenced routing; final Executor Authorization remains required',budgetGeniusCanary:rec});}
function budgetGeniusCanaryRuntimeRevoke(reason){const s=budgetGeniusCanaryRead();if(!s)return null;return budgetGeniusCanaryWrite(Object.assign({},s,{status:'REVOKED',rollbackReason:String(reason||'OPERATOR_REVOCATION'),revokedAt:Date.now()}));}
function budgetGeniusCanaryRuntimeStatus(){return budgetGeniusCanaryRead();}
